checks.name: ck_quiz_answer_payload
checks.sql: (input_recovered = true AND answer_hash IS NOT NULL AND ((choice IS NOT NULL AND text IS NULL) OR (choice IS NULL AND text IS NOT NULL))) OR (input_recovered = false AND legacy_answer IS NOT NULL AND choice IS NULL AND text IS NULL AND answer_hash IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_quiz_job_lease
checks.sql: (status = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > claimed_at) OR (status <> 'running' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_quiz_job_result
checks.sql: (status = 'succeeded' AND result IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'succeeded' AND result IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_quiz_submission_hash
checks.sql: (answer_set_hash IS NULL OR length(answer_set_hash) = 64) AND (input_recovered = false OR answer_set_hash IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_quiz_snapshot_metadata
checks.sql: (result_snapshot IS NULL AND result_provenance IS NULL AND result_schema_version IS NULL AND result_captured_at IS NULL) OR (result_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND result_provenance IS NOT NULL AND result_provenance IN ('submitted', 'legacy_reconstructed') AND result_schema_version IS NOT NULL AND result_captured_at IS NOT NULL AND result_captured_at >= sealed_at)
